messages:
erin: power cut + neighbor's backup generator made the main line noisy, so i set up in the basement next to the generator for steady power. pulled out some old powerline adapters to get ethernet downstairs. pics soon.
diego: basement office? novel. does powerline actually work over the noisy generator?
erin: surprisingly yes? one adapter in the breaker box, one by my laptop. throughput ~20 Mbps, jitter a bit spiky. had to swap the adapters to the other outlet to avoid a hum.
sasha: omg powerline adapters are the duct tape of networking :laughing: pics pls — also, did you try a foil parabolic for the phone hotspot?
erin: i did a napkin-grade parabolic with aluminum foil and a cereal box. somehow boosted signal by 2 bars to the 4G stick. the photo is wild. :metal:
tim: this is peak improvisation. you invented "cerealbox-beamforming". any logs?
erin: ran `iperf3 -c iperf.redwood.local -t 10` and saw 18 Mbps with occasional retransmits, though latency hovered 90-130ms. saved output to /home/erin/garage-ike.
diego: pro tip: set the powerline adapters to "homeplug green" mode if the generator is dirty power. also try a short ferrite on the laptop charger for noise.
erin: tried ferrite, helped a bit. also duct-taped the foil reflector to a broom handle for better aim. :broom: (uploaded pics) https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F90001/basement-setup.jpg https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F90002/cerealbox-antenna.jpg
sasha: this thread is a whole vibe. we should definitely add "weird antennas" to the emergency kit doc.
infrastructure-bot: Reminder: personal networking hardware must not be bridged to corporate VLANs. If you need a secure endpoint while on personal infrastructure, request a temporary infra VPN and approved config.
erin: noted infra-bot — i'm just using SSH + API tokens from my laptop, no bridging.
tim: also add "label your cables" to the checklist. i once unplugged an aquarium heater thinking it was a charger. :sweat_smile:
diego: vote: should we make a pinned gallery of WFH hacks? +1 from me :thumbsup:
sasha: +1 — category ideas: power tricks, mobile signal hacks, pet containment, snacks.
erin: i'll post a 1-paragraph how-to and the pics tonight. TL;DR: basement + powerline adapters + cereal-box antenna = surprisingly usable emergency office. bring duct tape.
